documents.population: International students with overseas qualifications applying directly to the University for undergraduate or postgraduate coursework (Australian Year 12 / IB-in-Australia applicants apply through UAC)
documents.notes: University of Sydney 'How to apply as an international student' page (steps for undergraduate or postgraduate coursework). A standing page; no year is printed. Also on the page: 'Other supporting documents may be required depending on your background, for example a change of name certificate or curriculum vitae'; 'Some programs may also require additional documents such as a supplementary form, personal statement or portfolio' (the program is not named; not drafted as items); electronic transcripts must come as a secure digital document from the school or an approved platform (My eQuals, MyCreds, Parchment, National Student Clearinghouse); international applicants may be asked to complete an additional Genuine Student (GS) assessment. Round 2's URL (/study/how-to-apply/international-students.html) redirects to an http:// URL that answers HTTP 405; the current https URL below is readable.

items.quote: Have overseas qualifications? Apply directly to the University from your course page or via an authorised agent.
You’ll need to include official documents with your application, such as academic certificates and transcripts,
academic certificates and transcripts, proof of English language proficiency and proof of identity
proof of English language proficiency and proof of identity (such as your passport).
If you have documents in languages other than English, you need to have them translated by a government-accredited translator such as NAATI, or your school’s registrar or equivalent department.
items.condition: documents in languages other than English

items.quote: If you're applying from China, check if you need your academic documents verified by China’s Center for Student Services and Development
items.condition: applying from China, where the academic documents need verification by China's Center for Student Services and Development

items.quote: Other supporting documents may be required depending on your background, for example a change of name certificate or curriculum vitae.
